scope: Preserve V8U through V8X, keep the V8W pairwise contact and free-flight qualification, replace LAW2 local EPSmax deletion with an explicit constant-strain /FAIL/JOHNSON criterion evaluated from /NONLOCAL/MAT plastic strain, and test 100, 50 and 25 mm diagonal mesh convergence plus time-step, thread and projectile-rupture ordering gates. V8Y is a bounded numerical regularization experiment on the same equivalent shell projectile and facade coupon; it is not a JT9D, whole-aircraft or global WTC 1 impact model.

regularization.material_law: /MAT/PLAS_JOHNS (LAW2), inherited V8W stress-strain curves with EPSmax set to zero
regularization.failure_model: /FAIL/JOHNSON with D1 equal to the declared constant plastic failure strain, D2=D3=D4=D5=0, Ifail_sh=1 and no XFEM
regularization.nonlocal_model: /NONLOCAL/MAT applied to facade, core and cowling materials
regularization.lemax_selection: Predeclared numerical upper bound equal to the coarsest mesh target, so the tested 100, 50 and 25 mm meshes are all at or below LeMAX. It is not a measured material length and is not calibrated to an impulse.

reference_failure_strains.status: Inherited V8W hypotheses, not measured component fracture surfaces

nonlocal_regularization.status: predeclared numerical mesh bound, not measured material length
